item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud glu ru'i thugs bcud las nyams khrid 'phrul mdzod zhus lan gnyis pa nges don zab mo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba
item.coloph: dbyings nyid mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso mo ste/ mkha' 'gro yum chen thugs rje kun sgrol gyis/ nub phyogs o rgyan spungs pa'i ri bo nas/ bdud rtsi bum pa 'dzin cing snyan du brgyud/ gsang ba'i bka' rgya bdag gis thub par byas/ de phyir 'gro la phan phyir yi ger btab/ man ngag bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o/ rig 'dzin chen po byang chub rdo rje rtsal gyis snyan du rgyud pa mu tsug smar ro//
